groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (147–148) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt dịch vụ ẩm thực (Catering) và Báo giá
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email from Karen Lewis to Gourmet Express):
Subject: Catering for Annual Gala on October 24
We are hosting our company annual gala for approximately 150 guests at the City Arts Pavilion on Saturday, October 24. We would like a three-course plated dinner featuring both vegetarian and seafood options. Could you provide a formal quote along with options for beverage service?

Document 2 (Reply from Marco Bellini, Gourmet Express):
Dear Ms. Lewis,
Thank you for considering Gourmet Express. We have attached our Autumn Deluxe Gala menu at $65 per person, which includes your choice of pan-seared sea bass or wild mushroom risotto. Premium beverage service is available for an additional $18 per person. For events booked more than two weeks in advance, we waive the $200 delivery and setup fee. Please sign and return the contract by October 10 to lock in your date.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (149–150) · Thông báo kiểm tra an toàn hệ thống báo cháy
groups.passage:
To All Tenants of Metro Business Tower:
Please be informed that City Fire Department inspectors will conduct the mandatory annual fire safety and alarm system testing on Wednesday, November 18, between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. During this testing window, alarm bells and strobe lights will activate intermittently for periods of 30 to 60 seconds. Building elevators will remain in operation except between 11:00 a.m. and 11:30 a.m., when emergency power generator tests will take place. No evacuation is required during the inspection. We apologize for any inconvenience.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (151–153) · Bài viết kinh doanh · Xu hướng mô hình làm việc linh hoạt
groups.passage:
Corporate Insights Magazine · October Edition
A recent survey conducted by the International Workplace Institute reveals that 74% of mid-size enterprises have permanently adopted flexible working arrangements. According to lead researcher Dr. Helena Vance, companies with flexible policies reported a 22% reduction in employee turnover and a 15% increase in applicant volume for technical positions. However, the report cautions that maintaining organizational cohesion requires deliberate investment in digital collaboration tools and structured quarterly team in-person summits.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (154–156) · Thông báo tuyển dụng · Chuyên viên Phân tích Dữ liệu
groups.passage: GreenLeaf Logistics is seeking a full-time Data Analyst to join our Operations team in Da Nang. Candidates should hold a bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, or a related field and have at least two years of experience with SQL and spreadsheet modeling. Fluency in English is required for weekly coordination with regional offices. Interested applicants should send a resume and cover letter to careers@greenleaf-logistics.example by November 30.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (157–160) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt in ấn & Lịch giao nhận
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email):
To: orders@harborprint.example
Subject: Brochure Order #904
We need 2,000 color brochures for our trade show opening on May 18. Could you confirm whether they can be delivered to Booth 12 at the Convention Center by May 16?

Document 2 (Reply):
Dear Ms. Pham,
We have scheduled your print run for May 12. Standard delivery takes three business days, which would put arrival on May 15—one day ahead of your deadline. Note that deliveries to the Convention Center require a loading dock pass, which our driver already holds.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (161–164) · Thông báo thay đổi chính sách bảo hành sản phẩm
groups.passage:
Notice to All Retail Partners:
Effective January 1, Apex Home Electronics will implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty on all kitchen appliances. Under the new policy, customers who register their serial number on our website within thirty days of purchase will receive an additional six months of complimentary coverage. Authorized service centers will now provide on-site repair for refrigerators and ovens at no extra charge. Replacement parts will be dispatched via express courier within 48 hours of warranty claim approval.

ets24-t04-q01.explanation: Kỹ thuật viên đang điều chỉnh thiết bị trên bàn thao tác. B, C, D không khớp với bối cảnh phòng thí nghiệm trong ảnh.
ets24-t04-q01.transcript:
(A) A technician is adjusting equipment on a workbench.
(B) Boxes are being loaded onto a truck.
(C) Scientists are looking out a window.
(D) Documents are scattered on the floor.
ets24-t04-q01.evidence: Một kỹ thuật viên đeo kính bảo hộ đang điều chỉnh thiết bị trên bàn làm việc.

ets24-t04-q02.explanation: “is seated on a bench reading” mô tả đúng tư thế ngồi đọc sách trên ghế dài. A sai động tác (chạy bộ); C và D sai đối tượng.
ets24-t04-q02.transcript:
(A) A man is jogging past a fountain.
(B) A man is seated on a bench reading a book.
(C) People are planting flowers in a garden.
(D) A bicycle is leaning against a fence.
ets24-t04-q02.evidence: Một người đàn ông đang ngồi đọc sách trên ghế dài dưới tán cây.

ets24-t04-q03.explanation: Hàng hóa được trưng bày gọn gàng trên kệ. A, B không có người trong khung hình; D không có biển treo trần.
ets24-t04-q03.transcript:
(A) Shoppers are pushing carts down an aisle.
(B) A clerk is stocking the top shelf.
(C) Merchandise is displayed neatly on shelves.
(D) Signs are hanging from the ceiling.
ets24-t04-q03.evidence: Các thùng hàng và sản phẩm được trưng bày ngay ngắn trên kệ siêu thị.

ets24-t04-q04.explanation: Công nhân đang điều khiển xe nâng để nâng pallet hàng trong kho. B, C, D không khớp với hành động trong kho hàng.
ets24-t04-q04.transcript:
(A) A warehouse worker is operating a forklift to lift a pallet.
(B) A painter is applying paint to a wall.
(C) Boxes are being loaded onto an airplane.
(D) Delivery trucks are parked in a row.
ets24-t04-q04.evidence: Một công nhân kho đang dùng xe nâng để nâng kiện hàng lên pallet.

ets24-t04-q05.explanation: Hai đồng nghiệp đang cùng nhìn vào màn hình laptop để thảo luận. B nhắc đến máy in; C viết bảng; D rời hội trường.
ets24-t04-q05.transcript:
(A) Two colleagues are looking at a laptop screen together.
(B) A printer is being repaired by a technician.
(C) Someone is writing on a whiteboard.
(D) Employees are leaving an auditorium.
ets24-t04-q05.evidence: Hai đồng nghiệp đang cùng nhìn vào màn hình máy tính xách tay và thảo luận.

ets24-t04-q06.explanation: Hành khách đang đứng chờ dưới mái che tại trạm xe buýt. A sai phương tiện (tàu điện ngầm); C sửa xe; D sang đường.
ets24-t04-q06.transcript:
(A) People are boarding a subway train.
(B) Passengers are waiting under a shelter at a bus stop.
(C) A mechanic is fixing a bus engine.
(D) Commuters are crossing an intersection.
ets24-t04-q06.evidence: Hành khách đang đứng chờ dưới mái che trạm dừng xe buýt bên lề đường.

ets24-t04-q07.explanation: Câu hỏi Why → đáp án A trả lời nguyên nhân với Because.
ets24-t04-q07.transcript:
Q: Why was the client meeting postponed?
(A) Because their flight was delayed by fog.
(B) In Conference Room B.
(C) Usually around noon.
ets24-t04-q07.evidence: Because their flight was delayed by fog.

ets24-t04-q08.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn A or B → không trả lời Yes/No, chọn phương án B.
ets24-t04-q08.transcript:
Q: Would you prefer coffee or green tea?
(A) Yes, I do.
(B) Green tea would be great, thanks.
(C) On the kitchen counter.
ets24-t04-q08.evidence: Green tea would be great, thanks.

ets24-t04-q09.explanation: How long hỏi khoảng thời gian → A trả lời khoảng 2 giờ.
ets24-t04-q09.transcript:
Q: How long will the system maintenance take?
(A) About two hours.
(B) By the IT department.
(C) Down the hallway.

ets24-t04-q10.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định kiểm tra tiến độ → A nêu rõ đã nộp cách đây 10 phút.
ets24-t04-q10.transcript:
Q: Haven’t you submitted the expense form yet?
(A) I handed it to accounting ten minutes ago.
(B) Around fifty dollars.
(C) The printer is out of paper.
ets24-t04-q10.evidence: I handed it to accounting ten minutes ago.

ets24-t04-q11.explanation: Lời nhờ giúp đỡ → A đồng ý và đề xuất lấy xe đẩy.
ets24-t04-q11.transcript:
Q: Could you help me carry these sample boxes upstairs?
(A) Sure, let me grab the cart.
(B) On the second shelf.
(C) They arrived yesterday.
ets24-t04-q11.evidence: Sure, let me grab the cart.

ets24-t04-q12.explanation: Which supplier hỏi nhà cung cấp nào → B nêu tên đơn vị.
ets24-t04-q12.transcript:
Q: Which supplier offered the lowest shipping rate?
(A) By express courier.
(B) Pacific Freight did.
(C) Last Friday.

ets24-t04-q13.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi xin đồng tình → A đồng ý và đưa ví dụ cụ thể.
ets24-t04-q13.transcript:
Q: The new software update is much faster, isn’t it?
(A) Yes, reports load almost instantly now.
(B) Update your password first.
(C) In the manual.
ets24-t04-q13.evidence: Yes, reports load almost instantly now.

ets24-t04-q14.explanation: How many hỏi số lượng → B trả lời 25 bản.
ets24-t04-q14.transcript:
Q: How many copies of the agenda should I print?
(A) At 9:30 a.m.
(B) Twenty-five should be enough.
(C) On recycled paper.

ets24-t04-q15.explanation: Where hỏi vị trí → A chỉ tủ văn phòng phẩm cạnh thang máy.
ets24-t04-q15.transcript:
Q: Where can I find extra toner cartridges?
(A) In the supply cabinet beside the elevator.
(B) About sixty pages.
(C) Yes, it prints in color.
ets24-t04-q15.evidence: In the supply cabinet beside the elevator.

ets24-t04-q16.explanation: Câu hỏi gián tiếp về sự có mặt → A trả lời ông ấy ra ngoài ăn trưa và sẽ quay lại lúc 1h.
ets24-t04-q16.transcript:
Q: Do you know if Mr. Park is in his office?
(A) He stepped out for lunch, but he’ll be back at one.
(B) A larger desk.
(C) No, I don’t use that program.
ets24-t04-q16.evidence: He stepped out for lunch, but he’ll be back at one.

ets24-t04-q17.explanation: Lời đề nghị Let’s... → A phản hồi đồng ý.
ets24-t04-q17.transcript:
Q: Let’s review the presentation slides before lunch.
(A) That sounds like a good plan.
(B) A sandwich and soup.
(C) Yes, I presented last month.
ets24-t04-q17.evidence: That sounds like a good plan.

ets24-t04-q18.explanation: What time hỏi giờ đóng cửa → B trả lời 6 giờ.
ets24-t04-q18.transcript:
Q: What time does the pharmacy close on Saturdays?
(A) Across from the bank.
(B) At six o’clock.
(C) For a prescription refill.

ets24-t04-q19.explanation: Who hỏi người giữ chìa khóa → A hướng dẫn hỏi David ở quầy lễ tân.
ets24-t04-q19.transcript:
Q: Who has the key to the storage room?
(A) Check with David at the front desk.
(B) Locked from the inside.
(C) Several chairs and tables.
ets24-t04-q19.evidence: Check with David at the front desk.

ets24-t04-q20.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn email hay gửi thư giấy → A chọn gửi email.
ets24-t04-q20.transcript:
Q: Should I email the invoice or mail a printed copy?
(A) Sending it by email is fine.
(B) Yes, I paid it.
(C) To the main branch.
ets24-t04-q20.evidence: Sending it by email is fine.

ets24-t04-q21.explanation: Câu nhận xét nêu vấn đề → A đề xuất giải pháp gọi bảo trì.
ets24-t04-q21.transcript:
Q: The air conditioning in this room feels quite warm.
(A) I’ll call building maintenance to check it.
(B) Every summer.
(C) On the fourth floor.
ets24-t04-q21.evidence: I’ll call building maintenance to check it.

ets24-t04-q22.explanation: How hỏi kết quả sự kiện → B mô tả số khách và phản hồi tích cực.
ets24-t04-q22.transcript:
Q: How did the product launch event go?
(A) By train.
(B) Over two hundred guests attended, and feedback was great.
(C) Next Wednesday.
ets24-t04-q22.evidence: Over two hundred guests attended, and feedback was great.

ets24-t04-q23.explanation: Hỏi còn chỗ trống không → A trả lời còn vài chỗ ở hàng cuối.
ets24-t04-q23.transcript:

(A) Only a few in the back row.
(B) From two to four.
(C) Yes, the speaker was helpful.
ets24-t04-q23.evidence: Only a few in the back row.

ets24-t04-q24.explanation: What kind of warranty → A nêu rõ bảo hành 2 năm.
ets24-t04-q24.transcript:
Q: What kind of warranty comes with this laptop?
(A) It includes a two-year parts and labor warranty.
(B) At the electronics store.
(C) About one kilogram.
ets24-t04-q24.evidence: It includes a two-year parts and labor warranty.

ets24-t04-q25.explanation: Đề nghị đi taxi → A từ chối khéo vì chỉ cách 2 dãy nhà nên đi bộ nhanh hơn.
ets24-t04-q25.transcript:
Q: Why don’t we take a taxi instead of walking?
(A) It’s only two blocks away, so walking is faster.
(B) Five dollars.
(C) Near the train station.
ets24-t04-q25.evidence: It’s only two blocks away, so walking is faster.

ets24-t04-q26.explanation: When hỏi lịch đánh giá → A nêu tuần đầu tháng 12.
ets24-t04-q26.transcript:

(A) They begin the first week of December.
(B) With your team leader.
(C) Very thorough.
ets24-t04-q26.evidence: They begin the first week of December.

ets24-t04-q27.explanation: Hỏi đã xem sơ đồ mới chưa → A trả lời chưa và hỏi lại chi tiết liên quan.
ets24-t04-q27.transcript:
Q: Have you seen the updated floor plan?
(A) Not yet—did they move the break room?
(B) On the third floor.
(C) Around 4:00 p.m.
ets24-t04-q27.evidence: Not yet—did they move the break room?

ets24-t04-q28.explanation: Where hỏi vị trí đỗ xe → A chỉ bãi đỗ dành cho khách phía sau hội trường chính.
ets24-t04-q28.transcript:
Q: Where can I park my car for the seminar?
(A) In the visitor lot behind the main hall.
(B) Yes, at nine o’clock.
(C) It was very informative.
ets24-t04-q28.evidence: In the visitor lot behind the main hall.

ets24-t04-q29.explanation: Who hỏi người phê duyệt → B trả lời ông Davis, giám đốc khối.
ets24-t04-q29.transcript:
Q: Who approved the revised marketing proposal?
(A) In two weeks.
(B) Mr. Davis, the division director.
(C) About ten pages long.

ets24-t04-q30.explanation: When hỏi thời điểm kiểm toán bắt đầu → A nêu ngày 15 tháng tới.
ets24-t04-q30.transcript:
Q: When will the annual finance audit begin?
(A) Starting on the 15th of next month.
(B) In the accounting office.
(C) By courier.
ets24-t04-q30.evidence: Starting on the 15th of next month.

ets24-t04-q31.explanation: Hỏi lô hàng đã đến chưa → A trả lời chưa và dự kiến đến chiều nay.
ets24-t04-q31.transcript:
Q: Has the shipment from Tokyo arrived yet?
(A) No, it’s expected this afternoon.
(B) Ten boxes of paper.
(C) Yes, I like Japanese food.

ets24-t04-q101.explanation: Thay thế cho danh từ số ít “the attached contract” ở vị trí tân ngữ → dùng đại từ “it”.
ets24-t04-q101.evidence: Please review the attached contract carefully before signing [it] at the bottom.

ets24-t04-q102.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “located” cần trạng từ “strategically”.
ets24-t04-q102.evidence: Our new warehouse is [strategically] located near the port to reduce shipping times.

ets24-t04-q103.explanation: “while + V-ing” diễn tả hành động diễn ra song song (trong khi vào cơ sở).
ets24-t04-q103.evidence: Visitors must wear an identification badge [while] entering the research facility.

ets24-t04-q104.explanation: Sau “the” và trước “of” cần danh từ “appointment” (việc bổ nhiệm).
ets24-t04-q104.evidence: The board of directors will announce the [appointment] of the new CEO next week.

ets24-t04-q105.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn “arrives”.
ets24-t04-q105.evidence: If the shipment [arrives] before noon, we can still assemble the display today.

ets24-t04-q106.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “planning” cần tính từ “careful”.
ets24-t04-q106.evidence: Thanks to [careful] planning, the office relocation was completed ahead of schedule.

ets24-t04-q107.explanation: “distribute” nghĩa là phân phát/gửi tới mọi người tham dự.
ets24-t04-q107.evidence: Mr. Tanaka asked his assistant to [distribute] the meeting minutes to all participants.

ets24-t04-q108.explanation: Cấu trúc Neither A nor B chia động từ theo danh từ gần nhất “technicians” (số nhiều) → “were”.
ets24-t04-q108.evidence: Neither the manager nor the technicians [were] aware of the power outage.

ets24-t04-q109.explanation: Sau tính từ “clear” cần danh từ số nhiều “instructions” (hướng dẫn).
ets24-t04-q109.evidence: The training manual provides clear [instructions] on how to operate the scanner.

ets24-t04-q110.explanation: Cụm từ cố định “at least” mang nghĩa ít nhất.
ets24-t04-q110.evidence: Guests who wish to cancel their reservation must do so at [least] 24 hours in advance.

ets24-t04-q111.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ so sánh hơn “higher” cần trạng từ “significantly”.
ets24-t04-q111.evidence: The quarterly sales figures were [significantly] higher than we had projected.

ets24-t04-q112.explanation: Cụm thành ngữ “go into effect” mang nghĩa có hiệu lực thi hành.
ets24-t04-q112.evidence: The revised corporate travel policy will go into [effect] at the beginning of next month.

ets24-t04-q113.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “leadership” cần tính từ “exceptional” (xuất sắc).
ets24-t04-q113.evidence: Mr. Lawson demonstrated [exceptional] leadership during the regional restructuring process.

ets24-t04-q114.explanation: Cụm cố định “at least” (ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm).
ets24-t04-q114.evidence: Applicants must have [at] least three years of experience in supply chain management.

ets24-t04-q115.explanation: Mệnh đề có chủ vị “the shipment was delayed” diễn tả sự tương phản → dùng liên từ “Although”.
ets24-t04-q115.evidence: [Although] the shipment was delayed by adverse weather, all packages arrived in perfect condition.

ets24-t04-q116.explanation: “before + V-ing” diễn tả hành động cần làm trước khi rời văn phòng.
ets24-t04-q116.evidence: Please ensure that all confidential documents are locked in the cabinet [before] leaving the office.

ets24-t04-q117.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ số nhiều “compliments” cần tính từ “numerous” (nhiều).
ets24-t04-q117.evidence: The customer service department has received [numerous] compliments regarding the new mobile banking app.

ets24-t04-q118.explanation: “while + mệnh đề” chỉ khoảng thời gian diễn ra song song khi CEO đi công tác.
ets24-t04-q118.evidence: Ms. Patel will present the quarterly earnings report [while] the CEO is away on business.

ets24-t04-q119.explanation: Cấu trúc “be dedicated to + V-ing” diễn tả sự tận tâm/cam kết cống hiến.
ets24-t04-q119.evidence: Our engineering team is dedicated to [reducing] energy consumption across all manufacturing units.

ets24-t04-q120.explanation: “provided that” mang nghĩa với điều kiện là / miễn là.
ets24-t04-q120.evidence: The warranty covers free repair [provided that] the product was purchased within the past 12 months.

ets24-t04-q121.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu “their” bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “opinions”.
ets24-t04-q121.evidence: All meeting attendees are encouraged to express [their] opinions during the brainstorming session.

ets24-t04-q122.explanation: “accommodate” mang nghĩa có sức chứa (chứa được đến 500 khách).
ets24-t04-q122.evidence: The newly renovated auditorium can [accommodate] up to 500 seated guests.

ets24-t04-q123.explanation: “by + ngày tháng” chỉ hạn chót nộp biểu mẫu.
ets24-t04-q123.evidence: To receive the early-bird registration discount, forms must be submitted [by] May 15.

ets24-t04-q124.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ “apologized” cần trạng từ “sincerely”.

ets24-t04-q125.explanation: Liên từ tương quan “Neither... nor...” (cả hai đều không).
ets24-t04-q125.evidence: Neither the marketing team [nor] the product development team was notified of the schedule change.

ets24-t04-q126.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho hành động “review” cần trạng từ “thoroughly” (cẩn trọng, kỹ lưỡng).

ets24-t04-q127.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ hoàn thành “have improved” cần trạng từ “steadily”.

ets24-t04-q128.explanation: “distributed” mang nghĩa được phân phát tới các trưởng bộ phận.

ets24-t04-q129.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều “contact details” đi với động từ nguyên mẫu “change” trong câu điều kiện.

ets24-t04-q130.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ “who” thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều “employees” → động từ chia “exceed”.

ets24-t04-q131.explanation: Cấu trúc “allow us to + V nguyên thể” → “reduce”.

ets24-t04-q138.explanation: Sau “to” chỉ mục đích dùng động từ nguyên mẫu “secure” (đảm bảo giữ chỗ).

Please be informed that City Fire Department inspectors will conduct the mandatory annual fire safety and alarm system testing on Wednesday, November 18, between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. During this testing window, alarm bells and strobe lights will activate intermittently for periods of 30 to 60 seconds. groups.passage:
Corporate Insights Magazine · October Edition
A recent survey conducted by the International Workplace Institute reveals that 74% of mid-size enterprises have permanently adopted flexible working arrangements. According to lead researcher Dr. Helena Vance, companies with flexible policies reported a 22% reduction in employee turnover and a 15% increase in applicant volume for technical positions. However, the report cautions that maintaining organizational cohesion requires deliberate investment in digital collaboration tools and structured quarterly team in-person summits.

ets24-t05-q101.explanation: Cấu trúc Neither A nor B chia động từ theo danh từ gần nhất “technicians” (số nhiều) → “were”.

ets24-t05-q102.explanation: Sau tính từ “clear” cần danh từ số nhiều “instructions” (hướng dẫn).
ets24-t05-q102.evidence: The training manual provides clear [instructions] on how to operate the scanner.

ets24-t05-q103.explanation: Cụm từ cố định “at least” mang nghĩa ít nhất.
ets24-t05-q103.evidence: Guests who wish to cancel their reservation must do so at [least] 24 hours in advance.

ets24-t05-q104.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ so sánh hơn “higher” cần trạng từ “significantly”.
ets24-t05-q104.evidence: The quarterly sales figures were [significantly] higher than we had projected.

ets24-t05-q105.explanation: Cụm thành ngữ “go into effect” mang nghĩa có hiệu lực thi hành.
ets24-t05-q105.evidence: The revised corporate travel policy will go into [effect] at the beginning of next month.

ets24-t05-q106.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “leadership” cần tính từ “exceptional” (xuất sắc).
ets24-t05-q106.evidence: Mr. Lawson demonstrated [exceptional] leadership during the regional restructuring process.

ets24-t05-q107.explanation: Cụm cố định “at least” (ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm).
ets24-t05-q107.evidence: Applicants must have [at] least three years of experience in supply chain management.

ets24-t05-q108.explanation: Mệnh đề có chủ vị “the shipment was delayed” diễn tả sự tương phản → dùng liên từ “Although”.
ets24-t05-q108.evidence: [Although] the shipment was delayed by adverse weather, all packages arrived in perfect condition.

ets24-t05-q109.explanation: “before + V-ing” diễn tả hành động cần làm trước khi rời văn phòng.
ets24-t05-q109.evidence: Please ensure that all confidential documents are locked in the cabinet [before] leaving the office.

ets24-t05-q110.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ số nhiều “compliments” cần tính từ “numerous” (nhiều).
ets24-t05-q110.evidence: The customer service department has received [numerous] compliments regarding the new mobile banking app.

ets24-t05-q111.explanation: “while + mệnh đề” chỉ khoảng thời gian diễn ra song song khi CEO đi công tác.
ets24-t05-q111.evidence: Ms. Patel will present the quarterly earnings report [while] the CEO is away on business.

ets24-t05-q112.explanation: Cấu trúc “be dedicated to + V-ing” diễn tả sự tận tâm/cam kết cống hiến.
ets24-t05-q112.evidence: Our engineering team is dedicated to [reducing] energy consumption across all manufacturing units.

ets24-t05-q113.explanation: “provided that” mang nghĩa với điều kiện là / miễn là.
ets24-t05-q113.evidence: The warranty covers free repair [provided that] the product was purchased within the past 12 months.

ets24-t05-q114.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu “their” bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “opinions”.
ets24-t05-q114.evidence: All meeting attendees are encouraged to express [their] opinions during the brainstorming session.

ets24-t05-q115.explanation: “accommodate” mang nghĩa có sức chứa (chứa được đến 500 khách).
ets24-t05-q115.evidence: The newly renovated auditorium can [accommodate] up to 500 seated guests.

ets24-t05-q116.explanation: “by + ngày tháng” chỉ hạn chót nộp biểu mẫu.
ets24-t05-q116.evidence: To receive the early-bird registration discount, forms must be submitted [by] May 15.

ets24-t05-q117.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ “apologized” cần trạng từ “sincerely”.
ets24-t05-q117.evidence: The hotel management apologized [sincerely] for the disruption caused by elevator maintenance.

ets24-t05-q118.explanation: Liên từ tương quan “Neither... nor...” (cả hai đều không).
ets24-t05-q118.evidence: Neither the marketing team [nor] the product development team was notified of the schedule change.

ets24-t05-q119.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho hành động “review” cần trạng từ “thoroughly” (cẩn trọng, kỹ lưỡng).
ets24-t05-q119.evidence: The legal counsel advised the executive committee to review the contract terms [thoroughly].

ets24-t05-q120.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ hoàn thành “have improved” cần trạng từ “steadily”.
ets24-t05-q120.evidence: Customer satisfaction ratings have improved [steadily] since the automated chat service was launched.

ets24-t05-q121.explanation: “distributed” mang nghĩa được phân phát tới các trưởng bộ phận.
ets24-t05-q121.evidence: Copies of the training schedule will be [distributed] to all department managers this afternoon.

ets24-t05-q122.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều “contact details” đi với động từ nguyên mẫu “change” trong câu điều kiện.
ets24-t05-q122.evidence: Please notify the human resources office immediately if your contact details [change].

ets24-t05-q123.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ “who” thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều “employees” → động từ chia “exceed”.
ets24-t05-q123.evidence: The company offers generous incentives for employees who [exceed] sales targets.

ets24-t05-q124.explanation: Cụm “every + số từ + danh từ số nhiều” chỉ tần suất định kỳ (mỗi 6 tháng một lần).
ets24-t05-q124.evidence: A comprehensive security inspection is conducted [every] six months.

ets24-t05-q125.explanation: “by + mốc thời gian” mang nghĩa trước hoặc muộn nhất là thời điểm đó (hạn nộp).
ets24-t05-q125.evidence: All employees are required to submit their travel receipts [by] Friday afternoon.

ets24-t05-q126.explanation: Trước danh từ “survey” cần tính từ “comprehensive” (toàn diện).
ets24-t05-q126.evidence: The marketing team conducted a [comprehensive] survey to understand customer preferences.

ets24-t05-q127.explanation: Có “since + mốc quá khứ” → dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành “has managed”.
ets24-t05-q127.evidence: Ms. Rivera [has managed] the regional branch since she joined the company in 2020.

ets24-t05-q128.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ “the heavy rain” → dùng giới từ chỉ sự nhượng bộ “Despite”.
ets24-t05-q128.evidence: [Despite] the heavy rain, the outdoor charity concert attracted over 500 attendees.

ets24-t05-q129.explanation: Thay thế cho danh từ số ít “the attached contract” ở vị trí tân ngữ → dùng đại từ “it”.
ets24-t05-q129.evidence: Please review the attached contract carefully before signing [it] at the bottom.

ets24-t05-q130.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “located” cần trạng từ “strategically”.

ets24-t05-q131.explanation: Trạng từ “specifically” bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “designed”.

ets24-t05-q132.explanation: Thông tin về giảng viên khách mời bổ sung chi tiết nội dung chương trình.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (147–148) · Bài viết kinh doanh · Xu hướng mô hình làm việc linh hoạt
groups.passage:
Corporate Insights Magazine · October Edition
A recent survey conducted by the International Workplace Institute reveals that 74% of mid-size enterprises have permanently adopted flexible working arrangements. According to lead researcher Dr. Helena Vance, companies with flexible policies reported a 22% reduction in employee turnover and a 15% increase in applicant volume for technical positions. However, the report cautions that maintaining organizational cohesion requires deliberate investment in digital collaboration tools and structured quarterly team in-person summits.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (151–153) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt in ấn & Lịch giao nhận
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email):
To: orders@harborprint.example
Subject: Brochure Order #904
We need 2,000 color brochures for our trade show opening on May 18. Could you confirm whether they can be delivered to Booth 12 at the Convention Center by May 16?

Document 2 (Reply):
Dear Ms. Pham,
We have scheduled your print run for May 12. Standard delivery takes three business days, which would put arrival on May 15—one day ahead of your deadline. Note that deliveries to the Convention Center require a loading dock pass, which our driver already holds.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (154–156) · Thông báo thay đổi chính sách bảo hành sản phẩm
groups.passage:
Notice to All Retail Partners:
Effective January 1, Apex Home Electronics will implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty on all kitchen appliances. Under the new policy, customers who register their serial number on our website within thirty days of purchase will receive an additional six months of complimentary coverage. Authorized service centers will now provide on-site repair for refrigerators and ovens at no extra charge. Replacement parts will be dispatched via express courier within 48 hours of warranty claim approval.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (157–160) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt dịch vụ ẩm thực (Catering) và Báo giá
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email from Karen Lewis to Gourmet Express):
Subject: Catering for Annual Gala on October 24
We are hosting our company annual gala for approximately 150 guests at the City Arts Pavilion on Saturday, October 24. We would like a three-course plated dinner featuring both vegetarian and seafood options. Could you provide a formal quote along with options for beverage service?

Document 2 (Reply from Marco Bellini, Gourmet Express):
Dear Ms. Lewis,
Thank you for considering Gourmet Express. We have attached our Autumn Deluxe Gala menu at $65 per person, which includes your choice of pan-seared sea bass or wild mushroom risotto. Premium beverage service is available for an additional $18 per person. For events booked more than two weeks in advance, we waive the $200 delivery and setup fee. Please sign and return the contract by October 10 to lock in your date.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (161–164) · Thông báo kiểm tra an toàn hệ thống báo cháy
groups.passage:
To All Tenants of Metro Business Tower:
Please be informed that City Fire Department inspectors will conduct the mandatory annual fire safety and alarm system testing on Wednesday, November 18, between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. During this testing window, alarm bells and strobe lights will activate intermittently for periods of 30 to 60 seconds. Building elevators will remain in operation except between 11:00 a.m. and 11:30 a.m., when emergency power generator tests will take place. No evacuation is required during the inspection. We apologize for any inconvenience.

ets24-t06-q101.explanation: Mệnh đề có chủ vị “the shipment was delayed” diễn tả sự tương phản → dùng liên từ “Although”.
ets24-t06-q101.evidence: [Although] the shipment was delayed by adverse weather, all packages arrived in perfect condition.

ets24-t06-q102.explanation: “before + V-ing” diễn tả hành động cần làm trước khi rời văn phòng.
ets24-t06-q102.evidence: Please ensure that all confidential documents are locked in the cabinet [before] leaving the office.

ets24-t06-q103.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ số nhiều “compliments” cần tính từ “numerous” (nhiều).
ets24-t06-q103.evidence: The customer service department has received [numerous] compliments regarding the new mobile banking app.

ets24-t06-q104.explanation: “while + mệnh đề” chỉ khoảng thời gian diễn ra song song khi CEO đi công tác.
ets24-t06-q104.evidence: Ms. Patel will present the quarterly earnings report [while] the CEO is away on business.

ets24-t06-q105.explanation: Cấu trúc “be dedicated to + V-ing” diễn tả sự tận tâm/cam kết cống hiến.
ets24-t06-q105.evidence: Our engineering team is dedicated to [reducing] energy consumption across all manufacturing units.

ets24-t06-q106.explanation: “provided that” mang nghĩa với điều kiện là / miễn là.
ets24-t06-q106.evidence: The warranty covers free repair [provided that] the product was purchased within the past 12 months.

ets24-t06-q107.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu “their” bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “opinions”.
ets24-t06-q107.evidence: All meeting attendees are encouraged to express [their] opinions during the brainstorming session.

ets24-t06-q108.explanation: “accommodate” mang nghĩa có sức chứa (chứa được đến 500 khách).
ets24-t06-q108.evidence: The newly renovated auditorium can [accommodate] up to 500 seated guests.

ets24-t06-q109.explanation: “by + ngày tháng” chỉ hạn chót nộp biểu mẫu.
ets24-t06-q109.evidence: To receive the early-bird registration discount, forms must be submitted [by] May 15.

ets24-t06-q110.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ “apologized” cần trạng từ “sincerely”.
ets24-t06-q110.evidence: The hotel management apologized [sincerely] for the disruption caused by elevator maintenance.

ets24-t06-q111.explanation: Liên từ tương quan “Neither... nor...” (cả hai đều không).
ets24-t06-q111.evidence: Neither the marketing team [nor] the product development team was notified of the schedule change.

ets24-t06-q112.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho hành động “review” cần trạng từ “thoroughly” (cẩn trọng, kỹ lưỡng).
ets24-t06-q112.evidence: The legal counsel advised the executive committee to review the contract terms [thoroughly].

ets24-t06-q113.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ hoàn thành “have improved” cần trạng từ “steadily”.
ets24-t06-q113.evidence: Customer satisfaction ratings have improved [steadily] since the automated chat service was launched.

ets24-t06-q114.explanation: “distributed” mang nghĩa được phân phát tới các trưởng bộ phận.
ets24-t06-q114.evidence: Copies of the training schedule will be [distributed] to all department managers this afternoon.

ets24-t06-q115.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều “contact details” đi với động từ nguyên mẫu “change” trong câu điều kiện.
ets24-t06-q115.evidence: Please notify the human resources office immediately if your contact details [change].

ets24-t06-q116.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ “who” thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều “employees” → động từ chia “exceed”.
ets24-t06-q116.evidence: The company offers generous incentives for employees who [exceed] sales targets.

ets24-t06-q117.explanation: Cụm “every + số từ + danh từ số nhiều” chỉ tần suất định kỳ (mỗi 6 tháng một lần).
ets24-t06-q117.evidence: A comprehensive security inspection is conducted [every] six months.

ets24-t06-q118.explanation: “by + mốc thời gian” mang nghĩa trước hoặc muộn nhất là thời điểm đó (hạn nộp).
ets24-t06-q118.evidence: All employees are required to submit their travel receipts [by] Friday afternoon.

ets24-t06-q119.explanation: Trước danh từ “survey” cần tính từ “comprehensive” (toàn diện).
ets24-t06-q119.evidence: The marketing team conducted a [comprehensive] survey to understand customer preferences.

ets24-t06-q120.explanation: Có “since + mốc quá khứ” → dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành “has managed”.
ets24-t06-q120.evidence: Ms. Rivera [has managed] the regional branch since she joined the company in 2020.

ets24-t06-q121.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ “the heavy rain” → dùng giới từ chỉ sự nhượng bộ “Despite”.
ets24-t06-q121.evidence: [Despite] the heavy rain, the outdoor charity concert attracted over 500 attendees.

ets24-t06-q122.explanation: Thay thế cho danh từ số ít “the attached contract” ở vị trí tân ngữ → dùng đại từ “it”.
ets24-t06-q122.evidence: Please review the attached contract carefully before signing [it] at the bottom.

ets24-t06-q123.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “located” cần trạng từ “strategically”.
ets24-t06-q123.evidence: Our new warehouse is [strategically] located near the port to reduce shipping times.

ets24-t06-q124.explanation: “while + V-ing” diễn tả hành động diễn ra song song (trong khi vào cơ sở).
ets24-t06-q124.evidence: Visitors must wear an identification badge [while] entering the research facility.

ets24-t06-q125.explanation: Sau “the” và trước “of” cần danh từ “appointment” (việc bổ nhiệm).
ets24-t06-q125.evidence: The board of directors will announce the [appointment] of the new CEO next week.

ets24-t06-q126.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn “arrives”.
ets24-t06-q126.evidence: If the shipment [arrives] before noon, we can still assemble the display today.

ets24-t06-q127.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “planning” cần tính từ “careful”.
ets24-t06-q127.evidence: Thanks to [careful] planning, the office relocation was completed ahead of schedule.

ets24-t06-q128.explanation: “distribute” nghĩa là phân phát/gửi tới mọi người tham dự.
ets24-t06-q128.evidence: Mr. Tanaka asked his assistant to [distribute] the meeting minutes to all participants.

ets24-t06-q129.explanation: Cấu trúc Neither A nor B chia động từ theo danh từ gần nhất “technicians” (số nhiều) → “were”.
ets24-t06-q129.evidence: Neither the manager nor the technicians [were] aware of the power outage.

ets24-t06-q130.explanation: Sau tính từ “clear” cần danh từ số nhiều “instructions” (hướng dẫn).
ets24-t06-q130.evidence: The training manual provides clear [instructions] on how to operate the scanner.

ets24-t06-q131.explanation: “provided that” mang nghĩa với điều kiện là nhu cầu vận hành được đảm bảo.

ets24-t06-q132.explanation: Yêu cầu phòng ban luôn có đủ nhân sự trực tiếp tại văn phòng mỗi ngày.
ets24-t06-q132.evidence: Department schedules should ensure adequate in-office coverage every weekday.

ets24-t06-q133.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu “will” dùng động từ nguyên mẫu “enhance”.

ets24-t06-q134.explanation: “continued dedication” (sự cống hiến bền bỉ / liên tục).

ets24-t06-q135.explanation: “Otherwise” (nếu không thì) nối hợp lý với cảnh báo thẻ cũ sẽ bị vô hiệu hóa.

ets24-t06-q136.explanation: Sau “are more” cần tính từ “secure” (bảo mật hơn).

ets24-t06-q137.explanation: Câu về mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân có ảnh liên kết trực tiếp với việc nhận thẻ mới.
ets24-t06-q137.evidence: Please bring a photo ID when picking up your card.

ets24-t06-q138.explanation: Sau “please” trong câu mệnh lệnh dùng động từ nguyên mẫu “notify”.

ets24-t06-q139.explanation: Thể bị động hoàn thành “has been processed” (đã được xử lý).

ets24-t06-q140.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu “can” dùng động từ nguyên thể không “to”.

ets24-t07-q02.explanation: Hành khách đang kéo vali có bánh xe dọc theo sân ga. B nhắc đến xe buýt; C nhắc đến công nhân sửa đường ray; D sai vị trí hành lý.

(A) A passenger is pulling a wheeled suitcase along the platform.
(B) Travelers are boarding a bus in a line.

ets24-t07-q03.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động hoàn thành diễn tả trạng thái: ghế đã được xếp quanh các bàn ngoài trời. A, B, D mô tả người đang hành động nhưng ảnh chỉ có cảnh bàn ghế trống.

ets24-t07-q03.evidence: Những chiếc ghế được xếp gọn quanh các bàn gỗ ngoài trời dưới mái hiên.

ets24-t07-q04.explanation: Kỹ thuật viên đang điều chỉnh thiết bị trên bàn thao tác. B, C, D không khớp với bối cảnh phòng thí nghiệm trong ảnh.

ets24-t07-q101.explanation: “accommodate” mang nghĩa có sức chứa (chứa được đến 500 khách).
ets24-t07-q101.evidence: The newly renovated auditorium can [accommodate] up to 500 seated guests.

ets24-t07-q102.explanation: “by + ngày tháng” chỉ hạn chót nộp biểu mẫu.
ets24-t07-q102.evidence: To receive the early-bird registration discount, forms must be submitted [by] May 15.

ets24-t07-q103.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ “apologized” cần trạng từ “sincerely”.
ets24-t07-q103.evidence: The hotel management apologized [sincerely] for the disruption caused by elevator maintenance.

ets24-t07-q104.explanation: Liên từ tương quan “Neither... nor...” (cả hai đều không).
ets24-t07-q104.evidence: Neither the marketing team [nor] the product development team was notified of the schedule change.

ets24-t07-q105.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho hành động “review” cần trạng từ “thoroughly” (cẩn trọng, kỹ lưỡng).
ets24-t07-q105.evidence: The legal counsel advised the executive committee to review the contract terms [thoroughly].

ets24-t07-q106.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ hoàn thành “have improved” cần trạng từ “steadily”.
ets24-t07-q106.evidence: Customer satisfaction ratings have improved [steadily] since the automated chat service was launched.

ets24-t07-q107.explanation: “distributed” mang nghĩa được phân phát tới các trưởng bộ phận.
ets24-t07-q107.evidence: Copies of the training schedule will be [distributed] to all department managers this afternoon.

ets24-t07-q108.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều “contact details” đi với động từ nguyên mẫu “change” trong câu điều kiện.
ets24-t07-q108.evidence: Please notify the human resources office immediately if your contact details [change].

ets24-t07-q109.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ “who” thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều “employees” → động từ chia “exceed”.
ets24-t07-q109.evidence: The company offers generous incentives for employees who [exceed] sales targets.

ets24-t07-q110.explanation: Cụm “every + số từ + danh từ số nhiều” chỉ tần suất định kỳ (mỗi 6 tháng một lần).
ets24-t07-q110.evidence: A comprehensive security inspection is conducted [every] six months.

ets24-t07-q111.explanation: “by + mốc thời gian” mang nghĩa trước hoặc muộn nhất là thời điểm đó (hạn nộp).
ets24-t07-q111.evidence: All employees are required to submit their travel receipts [by] Friday afternoon.

ets24-t07-q112.explanation: Trước danh từ “survey” cần tính từ “comprehensive” (toàn diện).
ets24-t07-q112.evidence: The marketing team conducted a [comprehensive] survey to understand customer preferences.

ets24-t07-q113.explanation: Có “since + mốc quá khứ” → dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành “has managed”.
ets24-t07-q113.evidence: Ms. Rivera [has managed] the regional branch since she joined the company in 2020.

ets24-t07-q114.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ “the heavy rain” → dùng giới từ chỉ sự nhượng bộ “Despite”.
ets24-t07-q114.evidence: [Despite] the heavy rain, the outdoor charity concert attracted over 500 attendees.

ets24-t07-q115.explanation: Thay thế cho danh từ số ít “the attached contract” ở vị trí tân ngữ → dùng đại từ “it”.
ets24-t07-q115.evidence: Please review the attached contract carefully before signing [it] at the bottom.

ets24-t07-q116.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “located” cần trạng từ “strategically”.
ets24-t07-q116.evidence: Our new warehouse is [strategically] located near the port to reduce shipping times.

ets24-t07-q117.explanation: “while + V-ing” diễn tả hành động diễn ra song song (trong khi vào cơ sở).
ets24-t07-q117.evidence: Visitors must wear an identification badge [while] entering the research facility.

ets24-t07-q118.explanation: Sau “the” và trước “of” cần danh từ “appointment” (việc bổ nhiệm).
ets24-t07-q118.evidence: The board of directors will announce the [appointment] of the new CEO next week.

ets24-t07-q119.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn “arrives”.
ets24-t07-q119.evidence: If the shipment [arrives] before noon, we can still assemble the display today.

ets24-t07-q120.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “planning” cần tính từ “careful”.
ets24-t07-q120.evidence: Thanks to [careful] planning, the office relocation was completed ahead of schedule.

ets24-t07-q121.explanation: “distribute” nghĩa là phân phát/gửi tới mọi người tham dự.
ets24-t07-q121.evidence: Mr. Tanaka asked his assistant to [distribute] the meeting minutes to all participants.

ets24-t07-q122.explanation: Cấu trúc Neither A nor B chia động từ theo danh từ gần nhất “technicians” (số nhiều) → “were”.
ets24-t07-q122.evidence: Neither the manager nor the technicians [were] aware of the power outage.

ets24-t07-q123.explanation: Sau tính từ “clear” cần danh từ số nhiều “instructions” (hướng dẫn).
ets24-t07-q123.evidence: The training manual provides clear [instructions] on how to operate the scanner.

ets24-t07-q124.explanation: Cụm từ cố định “at least” mang nghĩa ít nhất.
ets24-t07-q124.evidence: Guests who wish to cancel their reservation must do so at [least] 24 hours in advance.

ets24-t07-q125.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ so sánh hơn “higher” cần trạng từ “significantly”.
ets24-t07-q125.evidence: The quarterly sales figures were [significantly] higher than we had projected.

ets24-t07-q126.explanation: Cụm thành ngữ “go into effect” mang nghĩa có hiệu lực thi hành.
ets24-t07-q126.evidence: The revised corporate travel policy will go into [effect] at the beginning of next month.

ets24-t07-q127.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “leadership” cần tính từ “exceptional” (xuất sắc).
ets24-t07-q127.evidence: Mr. Lawson demonstrated [exceptional] leadership during the regional restructuring process.

ets24-t07-q128.explanation: Cụm cố định “at least” (ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm).
ets24-t07-q128.evidence: Applicants must have [at] least three years of experience in supply chain management.

ets24-t07-q129.explanation: Mệnh đề có chủ vị “the shipment was delayed” diễn tả sự tương phản → dùng liên từ “Although”.
ets24-t07-q129.evidence: [Although] the shipment was delayed by adverse weather, all packages arrived in perfect condition.

ets24-t07-q130.explanation: “before + V-ing” diễn tả hành động cần làm trước khi rời văn phòng.
ets24-t07-q130.evidence: Please ensure that all confidential documents are locked in the cabinet [before] leaving the office.

Notice to All Retail Partners:
Effective January 1, Apex Home Electronics will implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty on all kitchen appliances. Under the new policy, customers who register their serial number on our website within thirty days of purchase will receive an additional six months of complimentary coverage. Authorized service centers will now provide on-site repair for refrigerators and ovens at no extra charge. Replacement parts will be dispatched via express courier within 48 hours of warranty claim approval.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (151–153) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt dịch vụ ẩm thực (Catering) và Báo giá
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email from Karen Lewis to Gourmet Express):
Subject: Catering for Annual Gala on October 24
We are hosting our company annual gala for approximately 150 guests at the City Arts Pavilion on Saturday, October 24. We would like a three-course plated dinner featuring both vegetarian and seafood options. Could you provide a formal quote along with options for beverage service?

Document 2 (Reply from Marco Bellini, Gourmet Express):
Dear Ms. Lewis,
Thank you for considering Gourmet Express. We have attached our Autumn Deluxe Gala menu at $65 per person, which includes your choice of pan-seared sea bass or wild mushroom risotto. Premium beverage service is available for an additional $18 per person. For events booked more than two weeks in advance, we waive the $200 delivery and setup fee. Please sign and return the contract by October 10 to lock in your date.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (154–156) · Thông báo kiểm tra an toàn hệ thống báo cháy
groups.passage:
To All Tenants of Metro Business Tower:
Please be informed that City Fire Department inspectors will conduct the mandatory annual fire safety and alarm system testing on Wednesday, November 18, between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. During this testing window, alarm bells and strobe lights will activate intermittently for periods of 30 to 60 seconds. Building elevators will remain in operation except between 11:00 a.m. and 11:30 a.m., when emergency power generator tests will take place. No evacuation is required during the inspection. We apologize for any inconvenience.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (157–160) · Bài viết kinh doanh · Xu hướng mô hình làm việc linh hoạt
groups.passage:
Corporate Insights Magazine · October Edition
A recent survey conducted by the International Workplace Institute reveals that 74% of mid-size enterprises have permanently adopted flexible working arrangements. According to lead researcher Dr. Helena Vance, companies with flexible policies reported a 22% reduction in employee turnover and a 15% increase in applicant volume for technical positions. However, the report cautions that maintaining organizational cohesion requires deliberate investment in digital collaboration tools and structured quarterly team in-person summits.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (165–168) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt in ấn & Lịch giao nhận
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email):
To: orders@harborprint.example
Subject: Brochure Order #904
We need 2,000 color brochures for our trade show opening on May 18. Could you confirm whether they can be delivered to Booth 12 at the Convention Center by May 16?

Document 2 (Reply):
Dear Ms. Pham,
We have scheduled your print run for May 12. Standard delivery takes three business days, which would put arrival on May 15—one day ahead of your deadline. Note that deliveries to the Convention Center require a loading dock pass, which our driver already holds.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (169–172) · Thông báo thay đổi chính sách bảo hành sản phẩm
groups.passage:
Notice to All Retail Partners:
Effective January 1, Apex Home Electronics will implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty on all kitchen appliances. Under the new policy, customers who register their serial number on our website within thirty days of purchase will receive an additional six months of complimentary coverage. Authorized service centers will now provide on-site repair for refrigerators and ovens at no extra charge. Replacement parts will be dispatched via express courier within 48 hours of warranty claim approval.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (173–176) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt dịch vụ ẩm thực (Catering) và Báo giá
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email from Karen Lewis to Gourmet Express):
Subject: Catering for Annual Gala on October 24
We are hosting our company annual gala for approximately 150 guests at the City Arts Pavilion on Saturday, October 24. We would like a three-course plated dinner featuring both vegetarian and seafood options. Could you provide a formal quote along with options for beverage service?

Document 2 (Reply from Marco Bellini, Gourmet Express):
Dear Ms. Lewis,
Thank you for considering Gourmet Express. We have attached our Autumn Deluxe Gala menu at $65 per person, which includes your choice of pan-seared sea bass or wild mushroom risotto. Premium beverage service is available for an additional $18 per person. For events booked more than two weeks in advance, we waive the $200 delivery and setup fee. Please sign and return the contract by October 10 to lock in your date.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (177–180) · Thông báo kiểm tra an toàn hệ thống báo cháy
groups.passage:
To All Tenants of Metro Business Tower:
Please be informed that City Fire Department inspectors will conduct the mandatory annual fire safety and alarm system testing on Wednesday, November 18, between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. During this testing window, alarm bells and strobe lights will activate intermittently for periods of 30 to 60 seconds. Building elevators will remain in operation except between 11:00 a.m. and 11:30 a.m., when emergency power generator tests will take place. No evacuation is required during the inspection. We apologize for any inconvenience.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (181–185) · Bài viết kinh doanh · Xu hướng mô hình làm việc linh hoạt
groups.passage:
Corporate Insights Magazine · October Edition
A recent survey conducted by the International Workplace Institute reveals that 74% of mid-size enterprises have permanently adopted flexible working arrangements. According to lead researcher Dr. Helena Vance, companies with flexible policies reported a 22% reduction in employee turnover and a 15% increase in applicant volume for technical positions. However, the report cautions that maintaining organizational cohesion requires deliberate investment in digital collaboration tools and structured quarterly team in-person summits.

ets24-t08-q01.explanation: Hai đồng nghiệp đang cùng nhìn vào màn hình laptop để thảo luận. B nhắc đến máy in; C viết bảng; D rời hội trường.
ets24-t08-q01.transcript:
(A) Two colleagues are looking at a laptop screen together.
(B) A printer is being repaired by a technician.
(C) Someone is writing on a whiteboard.
(D) Employees are leaving an auditorium.
ets24-t08-q01.evidence: Hai đồng nghiệp đang cùng nhìn vào màn hình máy tính xách tay và thảo luận.

ets24-t08-q02.explanation: Hành khách đang đứng chờ dưới mái che tại trạm xe buýt. A sai phương tiện (tàu điện ngầm); C sửa xe; D sang đường.
ets24-t08-q02.transcript:
(A) People are boarding a subway train.
(B) Passengers are waiting under a shelter at a bus stop.
(C) A mechanic is fixing a bus engine.
(D) Commuters are crossing an intersection.
ets24-t08-q02.evidence: Hành khách đang đứng chờ dưới mái che trạm dừng xe buýt bên lề đường.

ets24-t08-q03.explanation: Lễ tân đang đưa thẻ khóa cho khách qua quầy tiếp tân. B, C, D không khớp với bối cảnh quầy lễ tân.
ets24-t08-q03.transcript:
(A) A receptionist is handing a keycard to a guest across the counter.
(B) Luggage has been left in an elevator.
(C) Chefs are preparing meals in a kitchen.
(D) Housekeepers are vacuuming the lobby rug.
ets24-t08-q03.evidence: Nhân viên tiếp tân đang trao thẻ phòng cho khách tại quầy lễ tân.

ets24-t08-q04.explanation: Người tham dự đang vỗ tay tán thưởng buổi thuyết trình. B, C, D không mô tả hành động vỗ tay.
ets24-t08-q04.transcript:
(A) Attendees are applauding at the end of a presentation.
(B) Notes are being erased from a blackboard.
(C) Microphones are being installed on the ceiling.
(D) The speaker is packing handouts into a briefcase.
ets24-t08-q04.evidence: Người tham dự đang vỗ tay tán thưởng sau khi bài phát biểu kết thúc.

ets24-t08-q05.explanation: Kỹ sư đội mũ bảo hộ đang xem xét bản vẽ thiết kế trên bàn làm việc. B, C, D không đúng với bối cảnh kiểm tra bản vẽ.
ets24-t08-q05.transcript:
(A) An engineer in a hard hat is examining a blueprint.
(B) Concrete is being poured into a foundation.
(C) Scaffolding has been dismantled around a tower.
(D) Workers are taking a break under a canopy.
ets24-t08-q05.evidence: Kỹ sư đeo mũ bảo hộ đang kiểm tra bản vẽ thiết kế trên bàn làm việc.

ets24-t08-q06.explanation: Mô tả chính xác hành động đang diễn ra: người phụ nữ đang chỉ vào biểu đồ khi thuyết trình. A sai vì không xóa bảng; C sai vì không bắt tay; D sai vì không cắm máy chiếu.
ets24-t08-q06.transcript:
(A) She is erasing the whiteboard.
(B) She is pointing at a chart during a presentation.
(C) They are shaking hands across the table.
(D) He is plugging in a projector.
ets24-t08-q06.evidence: Người phụ nữ đang đứng chỉ vào bảng trình bày trước hai đồng nghiệp ngồi quanh bàn.

ets24-t08-q07.explanation: Nhờ xem lại bản thảo → A đồng ý và bảo để một bản trên bàn làm việc.
ets24-t08-q07.transcript:
Q: Could you review this draft before I send it?
(A) Certainly, leave a copy on my desk.
(B) To the client.
(C) It was sent yesterday.
ets24-t08-q07.evidence: Certainly, leave a copy on my desk.

ets24-t08-q08.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi xin đồng tình về hệ thống thông gió → A đồng ý và giải thích vừa bảo trì động cơ quạt hôm qua.
ets24-t08-q08.transcript:
Q: The ventilation system is quite quiet today, isn’t it?
(A) Yes, they just serviced the fan motor yesterday.
(B) Turn right at the corner.
(C) No, I didn’t buy it.
ets24-t08-q08.evidence: Yes, they just serviced the fan motor yesterday.

ets24-t08-q09.explanation: Where hỏi nơi nộp hóa đơn thanh toán → A chỉ dẫn nộp cho phòng tài chính qua cổng trực tuyến.
ets24-t08-q09.transcript:
Q: Where should I submit the reimbursement receipts?
(A) To finance via the online portal.
(B) Twenty dollars.
(C) Next month.
ets24-t08-q09.evidence: To finance via the online portal.

ets24-t08-q10.explanation: Câu hỏi Where hỏi địa điểm → đáp án A chỉ nơi chốn (thư mục dùng chung trên máy chủ).
ets24-t08-q10.transcript:
Q: Where is the quarterly budget report?
(A) In the shared folder on the server.
(B) Next Tuesday morning.
(C) Yes, it was quite expensive.
ets24-t08-q10.evidence: In the shared folder on the server.

ets24-t08-q11.explanation: Câu hỏi Who hỏi người phụ trách → đáp án B nêu tên người và phòng ban.
ets24-t08-q11.transcript:
Q: Who will lead the orientation for new hires?
(A) Around twenty minutes.
(B) Ms. Takahashi from Human Resources.
(C) On the third floor.

ets24-t08-q12.explanation: Câu hỏi When hỏi thời gian/tần suất → đáp án A nêu lịch chạy định kỳ.
ets24-t08-q12.transcript:
Q: When does the shuttle bus to the airport leave?
(A) Every thirty minutes starting at 6:00 a.m.
(B) At Gate 4.
(C) I already booked the ticket.
ets24-t08-q12.evidence: Every thirty minutes starting at 6:00 a.m.

ets24-t08-q13.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No thì quá khứ → B xác nhận đã nhận email xác nhận.
ets24-t08-q13.transcript:
Q: Did you remember to confirm the hotel reservation?
(A) No, the conference room is full.
(B) Yes, I received the confirmation email this morning.
(C) Two nights for each guest.
ets24-t08-q13.evidence: Yes, I received the confirmation email this morning.

ets24-t08-q14.explanation: Câu hỏi Why → đáp án A trả lời nguyên nhân với Because.
ets24-t08-q14.transcript:
Q: Why was the client meeting postponed?
(A) Because their flight was delayed by fog.
(B) In Conference Room B.
(C) Usually around noon.
ets24-t08-q14.evidence: Because their flight was delayed by fog.

ets24-t08-q15.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn A or B → không trả lời Yes/No, chọn phương án B.
ets24-t08-q15.transcript:
Q: Would you prefer coffee or green tea?
(A) Yes, I do.
(B) Green tea would be great, thanks.
(C) On the kitchen counter.
ets24-t08-q15.evidence: Green tea would be great, thanks.

ets24-t08-q16.explanation: How long hỏi khoảng thời gian → A trả lời khoảng 2 giờ.
ets24-t08-q16.transcript:
Q: How long will the system maintenance take?
(A) About two hours.
(B) By the IT department.
(C) Down the hallway.

ets24-t08-q17.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định kiểm tra tiến độ → A nêu rõ đã nộp cách đây 10 phút.
ets24-t08-q17.transcript:
Q: Haven’t you submitted the expense form yet?
(A) I handed it to accounting ten minutes ago.
(B) Around fifty dollars.
(C) The printer is out of paper.
ets24-t08-q17.evidence: I handed it to accounting ten minutes ago.

ets24-t08-q18.explanation: Lời nhờ giúp đỡ → A đồng ý và đề xuất lấy xe đẩy.
ets24-t08-q18.transcript:
Q: Could you help me carry these sample boxes upstairs?
(A) Sure, let me grab the cart.
(B) On the second shelf.
(C) They arrived yesterday.
ets24-t08-q18.evidence: Sure, let me grab the cart.

ets24-t08-q19.explanation: Which supplier hỏi nhà cung cấp nào → B nêu tên đơn vị.
ets24-t08-q19.transcript:
Q: Which supplier offered the lowest shipping rate?
(A) By express courier.
(B) Pacific Freight did.
(C) Last Friday.

ets24-t08-q20.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi xin đồng tình → A đồng ý và đưa ví dụ cụ thể.
ets24-t08-q20.transcript:
Q: The new software update is much faster, isn’t it?
(A) Yes, reports load almost instantly now.
(B) Update your password first.

ets24-t08-q101.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều “contact details” đi với động từ nguyên mẫu “change” trong câu điều kiện.
ets24-t08-q101.evidence: Please notify the human resources office immediately if your contact details [change].

ets24-t08-q102.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ “who” thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều “employees” → động từ chia “exceed”.
ets24-t08-q102.evidence: The company offers generous incentives for employees who [exceed] sales targets.

ets24-t08-q103.explanation: Cụm “every + số từ + danh từ số nhiều” chỉ tần suất định kỳ (mỗi 6 tháng một lần).
ets24-t08-q103.evidence: A comprehensive security inspection is conducted [every] six months.

ets24-t08-q104.explanation: “by + mốc thời gian” mang nghĩa trước hoặc muộn nhất là thời điểm đó (hạn nộp).
ets24-t08-q104.evidence: All employees are required to submit their travel receipts [by] Friday afternoon.

ets24-t08-q105.explanation: Trước danh từ “survey” cần tính từ “comprehensive” (toàn diện).
ets24-t08-q105.evidence: The marketing team conducted a [comprehensive] survey to understand customer preferences.

ets24-t08-q106.explanation: Có “since + mốc quá khứ” → dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành “has managed”.
ets24-t08-q106.evidence: Ms. Rivera [has managed] the regional branch since she joined the company in 2020.

ets24-t08-q107.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ “the heavy rain” → dùng giới từ chỉ sự nhượng bộ “Despite”.
ets24-t08-q107.evidence: [Despite] the heavy rain, the outdoor charity concert attracted over 500 attendees.

ets24-t08-q108.explanation: Thay thế cho danh từ số ít “the attached contract” ở vị trí tân ngữ → dùng đại từ “it”.
ets24-t08-q108.evidence: Please review the attached contract carefully before signing [it] at the bottom.

ets24-t08-q109.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “located” cần trạng từ “strategically”.
ets24-t08-q109.evidence: Our new warehouse is [strategically] located near the port to reduce shipping times.

ets24-t08-q110.explanation: “while + V-ing” diễn tả hành động diễn ra song song (trong khi vào cơ sở).
ets24-t08-q110.evidence: Visitors must wear an identification badge [while] entering the research facility.

ets24-t08-q111.explanation: Sau “the” và trước “of” cần danh từ “appointment” (việc bổ nhiệm).
ets24-t08-q111.evidence: The board of directors will announce the [appointment] of the new CEO next week.

ets24-t08-q112.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn “arrives”.
ets24-t08-q112.evidence: If the shipment [arrives] before noon, we can still assemble the display today.

ets24-t08-q113.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “planning” cần tính từ “careful”.
ets24-t08-q113.evidence: Thanks to [careful] planning, the office relocation was completed ahead of schedule.

ets24-t08-q114.explanation: “distribute” nghĩa là phân phát/gửi tới mọi người tham dự.
ets24-t08-q114.evidence: Mr. Tanaka asked his assistant to [distribute] the meeting minutes to all participants.

ets24-t08-q115.explanation: Cấu trúc Neither A nor B chia động từ theo danh từ gần nhất “technicians” (số nhiều) → “were”.
ets24-t08-q115.evidence: Neither the manager nor the technicians [were] aware of the power outage.

ets24-t08-q116.explanation: Sau tính từ “clear” cần danh từ số nhiều “instructions” (hướng dẫn).
ets24-t08-q116.evidence: The training manual provides clear [instructions] on how to operate the scanner.

ets24-t08-q117.explanation: Cụm từ cố định “at least” mang nghĩa ít nhất.
ets24-t08-q117.evidence: Guests who wish to cancel their reservation must do so at [least] 24 hours in advance.

ets24-t08-q118.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ so sánh hơn “higher” cần trạng từ “significantly”.
ets24-t08-q118.evidence: The quarterly sales figures were [significantly] higher than we had projected.

ets24-t08-q119.explanation: Cụm thành ngữ “go into effect” mang nghĩa có hiệu lực thi hành.
ets24-t08-q119.evidence: The revised corporate travel policy will go into [effect] at the beginning of next month.

ets24-t08-q120.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “leadership” cần tính từ “exceptional” (xuất sắc).
ets24-t08-q120.evidence: Mr. Lawson demonstrated [exceptional] leadership during the regional restructuring process.

ets24-t08-q121.explanation: Cụm cố định “at least” (ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm).
ets24-t08-q121.evidence: Applicants must have [at] least three years of experience in supply chain management.

ets24-t08-q122.explanation: Mệnh đề có chủ vị “the shipment was delayed” diễn tả sự tương phản → dùng liên từ “Although”.
ets24-t08-q122.evidence: [Although] the shipment was delayed by adverse weather, all packages arrived in perfect condition.

ets24-t08-q123.explanation: “before + V-ing” diễn tả hành động cần làm trước khi rời văn phòng.
ets24-t08-q123.evidence: Please ensure that all confidential documents are locked in the cabinet [before] leaving the office.

ets24-t08-q124.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ số nhiều “compliments” cần tính từ “numerous” (nhiều).
ets24-t08-q124.evidence: The customer service department has received [numerous] compliments regarding the new mobile banking app.

ets24-t08-q125.explanation: “while + mệnh đề” chỉ khoảng thời gian diễn ra song song khi CEO đi công tác.
ets24-t08-q125.evidence: Ms. Patel will present the quarterly earnings report [while] the CEO is away on business.

ets24-t08-q126.explanation: Cấu trúc “be dedicated to + V-ing” diễn tả sự tận tâm/cam kết cống hiến.
ets24-t08-q126.evidence: Our engineering team is dedicated to [reducing] energy consumption across all manufacturing units.

ets24-t08-q127.explanation: “provided that” mang nghĩa với điều kiện là / miễn là.
ets24-t08-q127.evidence: The warranty covers free repair [provided that] the product was purchased within the past 12 months.

ets24-t08-q128.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu “their” bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “opinions”.
ets24-t08-q128.evidence: All meeting attendees are encouraged to express [their] opinions during the brainstorming session.

ets24-t08-q129.explanation: “accommodate” mang nghĩa có sức chứa (chứa được đến 500 khách).
ets24-t08-q129.evidence: The newly renovated auditorium can [accommodate] up to 500 seated guests.

ets24-t08-q130.explanation: “by + ngày tháng” chỉ hạn chót nộp biểu mẫu.
ets24-t08-q130.evidence: To receive the early-bird registration discount, forms must be submitted [by] May 15.

ets24-t08-q131.explanation: Thể bị động hoàn thành “has been processed” (đã được xử lý).

ets24-t08-q132.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu “can” dùng động từ nguyên thể không “to”.

ets24-t08-q133.explanation: Thời gian giao hàng dự kiến bổ sung trực tiếp cho việc theo dõi đơn.
ets24-t08-q133.evidence: Estimated delivery is within three business days.

ets24-t08-q134.explanation: “within + khoảng thời gian” mang nghĩa trong vòng 7 ngày kể từ khi nhận hàng.

ets24-t08-q135.explanation: “As a result” chỉ hệ quả trực tiếp của việc thay máy là hệ thống thông gió tạm ngắt.

ets24-t08-q136.explanation: Song song với tính từ “energy-efficient” sau “and” cần tính từ “quiet”.

ets24-t08-q137.explanation: Cam kết nhiệt độ bình thường được khôi phục trước sáng thứ Hai.
ets24-t08-q137.evidence: Normal indoor temperatures will be restored before staff return on Monday.

ets24-t08-q138.explanation: Sau “patience and” cần danh từ “cooperation” (sự hợp tác).

ets24-t08-q139.explanation: Cấu trúc “allow us to + V nguyên thể” → “reduce”.

ets24-t08-q140.explanation: Nêu thời điểm bắt đầu vận hành thương mại đầy đủ của trung tâm phân phối.
ets24-t08-q140.evidence: Full commercial operations are scheduled to commence on October 1.

ets24-t08-q141.explanation: Trước danh từ “attention” cần tính từ “meticulous” (tỉ mỉ, cẩn trọng).

ets24-t08-q142.explanation: Chủ ngữ “we” trong mệnh đề thời gian hiện tại dùng “expand”.

ets24-t08-q143.explanation: Trạng từ “specifically” bổ nghĩa cho phân từ “designed”.

ets24-t08-q144.explanation: Thông tin về giảng viên khách mời bổ sung chi tiết nội dung chương trình.
ets24-t08-q144.evidence: Guest lecturers from top business schools will lead interactive case studies.

ets24-t08-q145.explanation: “Those who + V số nhiều (wish)” chỉ những người muốn tham dự.

ets24-t08-q146.explanation: Sau “to” chỉ mục đích dùng động từ nguyên mẫu “secure” (đảm bảo giữ chỗ).

ets24-t08-q147.explanation: Căn cứ trực tiếp trong bài đọc: “2,000 color brochures”. Do đó đáp án đúng là (B).

ets24-t08-q148.explanation: Căn cứ trực tiếp trong bài đọc: “trade show opening on May 18”. Do đó đáp án đúng là (D).

ets24-t08-q149.explanation: Căn cứ trực tiếp trong bài đọc: “implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty”. Do đó đáp án đúng là (B).
ets24-t08-q149.evidence: implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty

ets24-t08-q150.explanation: Căn cứ trực tiếp trong bài đọc: “register their serial number on our website within thirty days”. Do đó đáp án đúng là (B).

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (147–148) · Thông báo thay đổi chính sách bảo hành sản phẩm
groups.passage:
Notice to All Retail Partners:
Effective January 1, Apex Home Electronics will implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty on all kitchen appliances. Under the new policy, customers who register their serial number on our website within thirty days of purchase will receive an additional six months of complimentary coverage. Authorized service centers will now provide on-site repair for refrigerators and ovens at no extra charge. Replacement parts will be dispatched via express courier within 48 hours of warranty claim approval.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (149–150) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt dịch vụ ẩm thực (Catering) và Báo giá
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email from Karen Lewis to Gourmet Express):
Subject: Catering for Annual Gala on October 24
We are hosting our company annual gala for approximately 150 guests at the City Arts Pavilion on Saturday, October 24. We would like a three-course plated dinner featuring both vegetarian and seafood options. Could you provide a formal quote along with options for beverage service?

Document 2 (Reply from Marco Bellini, Gourmet Express):
Dear Ms. Lewis,
Thank you for considering Gourmet Express. We have attached our Autumn Deluxe Gala menu at $65 per person, which includes your choice of pan-seared sea bass or wild mushroom risotto. Premium beverage service is available for an additional $18 per person. For events booked more than two weeks in advance, we waive the $200 delivery and setup fee. Please sign and return the contract by October 10 to lock in your date.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (151–153) · Thông báo kiểm tra an toàn hệ thống báo cháy
groups.passage:
To All Tenants of Metro Business Tower:
Please be informed that City Fire Department inspectors will conduct the mandatory annual fire safety and alarm system testing on Wednesday, November 18, between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. During this testing window, alarm bells and strobe lights will activate intermittently for periods of 30 to 60 seconds. Building elevators will remain in operation except between 11:00 a.m. and 11:30 a.m., when emergency power generator tests will take place. No evacuation is required during the inspection. We apologize for any inconvenience.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (154–156) · Bài viết kinh doanh · Xu hướng mô hình làm việc linh hoạt
groups.passage:
Corporate Insights Magazine · October Edition
A recent survey conducted by the International Workplace Institute reveals that 74% of mid-size enterprises have permanently adopted flexible working arrangements. According to lead researcher Dr. Helena Vance, companies with flexible policies reported a 22% reduction in employee turnover and a 15% increase in applicant volume for technical positions. However, the report cautions that maintaining organizational cohesion requires deliberate investment in digital collaboration tools and structured quarterly team in-person summits.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (157–160) · Thông báo tuyển dụng · Chuyên viên Phân tích Dữ liệu
groups.passage: GreenLeaf Logistics is seeking a full-time Data Analyst to join our Operations team in Da Nang. Candidates should hold a bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, or a related field and have at least two years of experience with SQL and spreadsheet modeling. Fluency in English is required for weekly coordination with regional offices. Interested applicants should send a resume and cover letter to careers@greenleaf-logistics.example by November 30.

Notice to All Retail Partners:
Effective January 1, Apex Home Electronics will implement an enhanced two-year limited warranty on all kitchen appliances. Under the new policy, customers who register their serial number on our website within thirty days of purchase will receive an additional six months of complimentary coverage. Authorized service centers will now provide on-site repair for refrigerators and ovens at no extra charge. Replacement parts will be dispatched via express courier within 48 hours of warranty claim approval.

groups.title: Đọc hiểu Part 7 (196–200) · Chuỗi văn bản · Email đặt dịch vụ ẩm thực (Catering) và Báo giá
groups.passage:
Document 1 (Email from Karen Lewis to Gourmet Express):
Subject: Catering for Annual Gala on October 24
We are hosting our company annual gala for approximately 150 guests at the City Arts Pavilion on Saturday, October 24. We would like a three-course plated dinner featuring both vegetarian and seafood options. Could you provide a formal quote along with options for beverage service?

Document 2 (Reply from Marco Bellini, Gourmet Express):
Dear Ms. Lewis,
Thank you for considering Gourmet Express. We have attached our Autumn Deluxe Gala menu at $65 per person, which includes your choice of pan-seared sea bass or wild mushroom risotto. Premium beverage service is available for an additional $18 per person. For events booked more than two weeks in advance, we waive the $200 delivery and setup fee. Please sign and return the contract by October 10 to lock in your date.
